$comment: Audit trail for clause citations that are referenced by decision nodes but whose state has no ingest adapter yet. These clauses render as honest 'text pending' cards — the app never shows words for them — but the citation itself must still be right, because a child sees it and a teacher may follow the link. Each entry records how the citation was verified and when. When a state's adapter lands, its entries move to the published corpus and this record becomes the pre-ingest history.

verified.subject: 60% voter approval required for a constitutional amendment
verified.method: web research against flsenate.gov (official) and secondary mirrors; page fetch was blocked from the build environment, so the quote was corroborated across independent search extractions rather than retrieved first-party
verified.caveat: The 60% rule is the general threshold. Article XI, Section 7 requires two-thirds for amendments imposing a new state tax or fee. The game option is written as the general rule, not as an absolute.

verified.citation: New Hampshire Constitution, Part Second, Article 100
verified.subject: two-thirds of voters required to ratify a constitutional amendment
verified.method: web research against nh.gov and Justia; page fetch blocked from the build environment, corroborated across independent search extractions
verified.caveat: Two-thirds is the ratification threshold at the polls. The three-fifths figure sometimes quoted is the separate legislative threshold for proposing an amendment.

unverified.$note: Referenced by seed decisions since the original scaffold, not yet re-verified in this session. Each renders as a pending card with no text. Verify before any classroom pilot.
